name.en-US: Our Lord's Sermon on the Mount
name.pt-BR: O Sermão de Nosso Senhor na Montanha

sources.edition: Maurist text (Benedictines of Saint-Maur, 1679-1700) as printed in Migne, Patrologia Latina, on augustinus.it (Corpus Augustinianum Gissense / NBA Latin pages)
sources.description: Latin pages montagna of augustinus.it, one page per book/letter/sermon, split to the same chapter files as the English. The Italian NBA headings, summaries and biblical-reference notes are dropped; section numbers and italicised quotations are kept. Raw mirror in research/sourcing/augustine-latin/raw.
sources.tierEvidence: Text of a 4th-5th-century work in the Maurist edition (1679-1700, Migne 1841-49), long public domain.

sources.description: Translated by William Findlay. From Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers, First Series, Vol. 6, Edited by Philip Schaff, Buffalo, NY: Christian Literature Publishing Co 1888. Revised and edited for New Advent by Kevin Knight.
